ledger.note: 42 BC: Sextus Pompey's Sicily. Timeline: '42 BC – controls Sicily with a powerful navy'; 'with the whole island of Sicily as his base'; infobox rank 'Prefect of the fleet and the coast; Governor of Sicily and Sardinia'. A Roman faction state held against the triumvirs (rule 5: rebel).
42 BC: Sicily passes from the Republic's control to Sextus; the mirror of roman-republic's loss.
42 BC: the Sicilian war (Bellum Siculum in the infobox) opens; the Republic's own dossier carries the same contest.

40 BC: 'He captured Sardinia in 40 BC for Sextus, driving out Octavian's governor Marcus Lurius' (Menas page, opened eu-03-b-fix 2026-10-19); the Sextus Pompey page: 'in 40 BC Sextus' admiral, the freedman Menas, seized Sardinia from Octavian's governor Marcus Lurius'. Corsica is not named on either page; confidence 2.
40 BC: the contest over the islands begins with the seizure.
38 BC: 'In 38 BC Menas surrendered Sardinia to Octavian and received equestrian rank as a reward.' Corsica is not named; confidence 2.
38 BC: the islands are Octavian's again.

September 36 BC: 'In the Battle of Naulochus, Agrippa destroyed the remainder of Sextus' fleet' (Mylae in August 36 and 'again a month later'); Lepidus and Statilius Taurus invaded Sicily and Sextus lost his base; he 'was finally captured in 35 BC, and executed without trial in Miletus'.
September 36 BC: the contest ends with Naulochus.
September 36 BC: the faction state ends with the loss of Sicily; Sextus flees to Asia Minor and dies in 35.

wars.name: Sicilian War against Sextus Pompey
wars.outcome: Pact of Misenum 39 ('Pompey was given legitimate control over Sicily and Sardinia in exchange for keeping the grain supply to Rome open'); the war resumed ('Octavian was defeated in the naval battle of Messina (37 BC)'); Naulochus 36; Sextus executed 35.
wars.note: The war's own Wikipedia page 'Sicilian revolt' is a disambiguation list; this war is cited to the Sextus Pompey page.

certainty.note: A faction's island territory: Sicily and, 40-38, Sardinia and Corsica; no border is drawn on any page.

sources.title: Sextus Pompey
sources.note: Sicily as his base (timeline 42 BC), Sardinia 40, Pact of Misenum 39, Messina 37, Mylae and Naulochus 36, death 35.

notes: Rebel dossier added by eu-03-b (second round, 2026-10-19) because roman-republic carries 'sextus-pompeius' as a counterpart; Cliopatria has no row for it. Wikidata id left null (Wikidata is unreachable). No capital: the Sextus Pompey page names no headquarters (Messina appears only as the site of the naval battle of 37). Corsica is not named on either page; it is included with Sardinia at confidence 2 because the two islands were one province. The dates 42 (Sicily), 40 and 38 (Sardinia) and September 36 (Naulochus) are the pages'. The Wikipedia page for the war itself ('Sicilian revolt') is a disambiguation list.
